text:
lucas: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR to align CLI examples and webhook docs for the v1->v2 migration. Found 3 CLI samples using `--model-id` and a webhook payload example still expecting `model_id` in the top-level. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 :mag_right:
anya: thanks — this is blocking a support thread. can we keep a tiny compatibility note for customers on the shim? don't want to break copy-paste scripts.
sophia: product wants a short deprecation line in the guides: 'v1 shim supported until 2025-12-31'. put it in the changelog and the quickstarts.
kevin: quick scan: docs/cli/usage.md uses `--model-id`. we should standardize on `--model`. webhook example in docs/webhooks.md still shows `{"model_id":"gpt-3.5","output":"..."}` — new shape is `{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","outputs": [...]}`.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] example-lint failed on docs/webhooks.md: expected property `outputs` not `output`.
lucas: plan: make v2 canonical everywhere, add a one-line banner noting compatibility + a collapsible "v1 -> v2 quick map" on affected pages. Add a tiny CLI shim snippet (single-line) to help scripted users.
anya: I'll sweep CLI docs and add a sed example to help maintainers update repos. old -> new sample:
```bash
# v1 style
redwood-cli generate --model-id gpt-3.5 --input "hi"
# v2 canonical
redwood-cli generate --model gpt-4o-mini --input "hi"
# quick replace for maintainer scripts
sed -i 's/--model-id/--model/g' $(git ls-files '*.md')
```
kevin: i'll update the webhook payloads and add a test fixture under tests/fixtures/webhooks/v2.json. pushing shortly.
sophia: also add an embeddings note: `embed-legacy-512` -> `rwd-embed-512-v2` and link to /assets/alias_map_v2.json. this prevents surprises when people call the old alias.
lucas: action items: (1) Anya: CLI flag sweep + sed snippet + update CLI quickstart; (2) Kevin: webhook payload examples, test fixture, and CI test; (3) Sophia: embed alias note + changelog blurb; (4) Lucas: review + merge after CI green. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024/files
docs-ci-bot: [ci] queued example tests for PR 1024. ETA ~12m.
kevin: pushed webhook fixture and updated examples. docs-ci-bot: [ci] examples job failed on one test: docs/cli/usage.md expected `--model` but CI snapshot still had `--model-id`.
anya: fixed remaining instances and pushed. added a tiny paragraph under the CLI quickstart: "If you still use scripts with --model-id, update to --model or use the compat shim: `alias redwood-cli='redwood-cli --model'` (not recommended long-term)."
lucas: nice. once CI is green we'll merge. small comms note: product wants the deprecation line included in the doc changelog and in the customer email. Sophia, can you draft the one-liner?
sophia: will do. suggested blurb: "Docs examples consolidated to v2 canonical patterns; the v1 shim remains available until 2025-12-31."
lucas: perfect. merging after approvals. :shipit:
